info.name: CNG Finder - Authentication APIs
info.description:
Complete Authentication API Collection - Signup, Login, Forgot Password, Reset Password, User Profile

API Endpoints:
1. POST /api/auth/signup - Register new user
2. POST /api/auth/login - Login user
3. POST /api/auth/forgot-password - Request password reset code
4. POST /api/auth/reset-password - Reset password with code
5. GET /api/auth/user - Get user profile (requires auth)

Base URL: Change the variable below to your server URL
Auto Token: Login request automatically saves JWT token

variable.description: JWT authentication token (automatically saved after successful login)

request.description:
Register a new user account

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- name: 2-100 characters
- emailOrPhone: Valid email OR 10-15 digit phone number
- password: Min 6 chars, must contain letter + number
- confirmPassword: Must match password

SUCCESS RESPONSE (201):
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User registered successfully. Welcome!",
  "data": {
    "user": { id, name, email, phone },
    "token": "JWT_TOKEN"
  }
}

ERROR RESPONSES:
- 400: Validation error
- 409: User already exists
- 500: Server error

exec: // Auto-save token if login is successful
console.log('✅ Login successful! Token saved:', jsonData.data.token);

request.description:
Login with email/phone and password

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- emailOrPhone: Registered email OR phone number
- password: User password

SUCCESS RESPONSE (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Login successful. Welcome back!",
  "data": {
    "user": { id, name, email, phone },
    "token": "JWT_TOKEN"
  }
}

ERROR RESPONSES:
- 400: Validation error
- 401: Invalid credentials
- 500: Server error

Token is automatically saved after successful login!

item.name: 3. GET USER PROFILE - Get Logged-in User Info

request.description:
Get current logged-in user profile information

REQUIRED:
- Authorization header with Bearer token
- Login first to get the token (auto-saved)

SUCCESS RESPONSE (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User profile retrieved successfully.",
  "data": {
    "user": { id, name, email, phone, isActive }
  }
}

ERROR RESPONSES:
- 401: No token provided / Invalid token
- 403: Token expired
- 404: User not found
- 500: Server error

request.description:
Request a password reset code

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- emailOrPhone: Registered email OR phone number

SUCCESS RESPONSE (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "If an account exists, you will receive a reset code",
  "debug_resetToken": "123456"  // Only in development
}

How it works:
1. Enter your registered email/phone
2. System generates 6-digit code
3. Code is logged to console (in development)
4. Use this code in Reset Password API

Note: In production, code is sent via SMS/Email

Reset password using the code received

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- token: 6-digit reset code from Forgot Password API
- newPassword: Min 6 chars, must contain letter + number
- confirmPassword: Must match newPassword

SUCCESS RESPONSE (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Password reset successful. Please login with your new password."
}

ERROR RESPONSES:
- 400: Invalid/expired token or validation error
- 500: Server error

Workflow:
1. Call Forgot Password API first
2. Get the 6-digit code from console/email
3. Enter code + new password here
4. After success, login with new password
